hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.age|*.key) echo 'BLOCK: Encrypted/key files should not be edited directly' && exit 1;; esac
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *go.sum) echo 'BLOCK: go.sum should not be edited directly — use go mod tidy' && exit 1;; esac
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f";; esac
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.go) cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && go vet ./... 2>&1 | head -20;; esac
